svg.text: Train and register a model, approve it explicitly, then deploy the selected version through Git.
Local CLI or AWS Kubernetes Job
VPC · IAM · ARM EC2 running k3s
EBS volumes · S3 bucket · ECR repositories
Compare Git to cluster · detect drift
Propose image tags in a PR
Matched observations + exact served model → explicit quality verification → ConfigMap → API metrics
EBS: k3s state, MLflow SQLite, training cache / PVCs • S3: AWS MLflow artifact bundles • Local lab: SQLite + local artifacts / k3d PVCs
Automation boundary: scheduled training is suspended by default; champion promotion and Argo sync are explicit operator actions.
